video_title: Giannis Gets Traded Before the Draft? — Marc Spears

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis's trade power and the Bucks' priority for their own best interest
quotes.excerpt: The Bucks are going to do what's best for them, not what's best for Giannis.
quotes.quote: The one thing I wonder with Giannis is like how much power does he have and where they trade him and does this relatively new owner there really care. Does he have a relationship with Giannis? I do think with Giannis and the Bucks, the Bucks are going to do what's best for them, not what's best for Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is a 'wonder of the world' best seen in person
quotes.excerpt: He's like one of the wonders of the world. You have to see it in person.
quotes.quote: Even if you just got a little bit of money, put your nickels together in a jar to go watch Wemby play. You got to get it in person. It sounds it looks great on TV, but I'm telling you he's like one of the wonders of the world. You have to see it in person. And what I saw from him, and just the dunks, the block shots, everything looks like a little kid on a Nerf hoop. It's just absolutely incredible and to think that he's under 25 years old right now. And just so motivated for greatness and really cares. It's just amazing.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Marc Spears defends Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's unique and effective playing style
quotes.excerpt: His ability to hit some of the most unique shots, get to the line, lead that team, hit clutch shots.

text_blocks.text: Yeah, I mean, he reminded me that he can also stand on his feet after a shot. I charted it earlier today. He took 24 shots from the field. He only fell down eight times, Mark. That's got to be a good sign.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc Spears
text_blocks.text: I, you know what, I'm not a SGA hater, man. I think I'm the only one. And maybe he smooths me because he he takes my questions probably more than most people. But hey, I have no apologies for the way he takes the ball to the hole. You don't have to foul him, you don't have to fall for his antics and I'm sure it drives some of the referees nuts, right? But his ability to hit some of the most unique shots, get to the line, lead that team, hit clutch shots. There's more love than hate when it comes to me and SGA.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA Finals' youth and talent highlight Warriors' need to get younger and prepare for life without Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: Not only making the team younger but preparing for life without Steph.
quotes.quote: Well, first of all, and I'm sure the Knicks and the Cavaliers would feel differently. You can make an argument that we're really watching the NBA Finals in that series. Those are the two best teams. I think it's hard to argue against that. The one thing that both of those two teams have is a tremendous amount of not only talent but youth. And that's why probably keeping the 11th pick, I mean look, you're not going to be as young as the Thunder or Spurs tomorrow. You may never be. But, when you start getting a piece that like that's in the 11th pick can be, I think you start in the direction of not only making the team younger but preparing for life without Steph.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's delayed free agency decision could benefit other teams, as Lakers can't wait
quotes.excerpt: The LeBron James free agency is going to be quite interesting from a lot of standpoints.
quotes.quote: He's talking about maybe waiting to August or September and if he waits to August or September to make a decision, to me, that probably benefits maybe the Warriors or the Cleveland Cavaliers or another team outside the Lakers because I don't think the Lakers can sit on $58 million in salary and just wait on him to make a decision. And I'm not sure I know how much the Lakers want him or not. I would assume they would want him back then you got to wonder at what price. So the LeBron James free agency is going to be quite interesting from a lot of standpoints. And I do wonder if, behind the scenes, maybe Steph and Draymond are trying to tap him on the shoulder, but there's no money for the Warriors to give him. I mean, you're not going to do a sign and trade, right? So I think for a team like the Warriors, you're hoping that if you have interest in LeBron James, and I'm not saying that they do, that they renounce him and make him a free agent and then maybe the Warriors can be creative.
